title: Trade Tender
shortDescription: UK construction tenders and quotes for Buyers and Suppliers.
fullDescription:
Trade Tender is for UK construction Buyers and Suppliers. Set out a job, compare quotes on the same brief, and award the work. Names and phone numbers stay private until a site visit is booked or you accept a quote.

For Buyers
Create a tender with the trade, quantity, location, and deadline. Matched Suppliers quote the same written brief. Compare price, lead time, and documents, then accept a quote with a purchase order number.

For Suppliers
See jobs that match your services and area. Unlock a tender, ask questions, and submit a quote. For contractor and professional jobs you can pay a fixed fee to contact the Buyer for a site visit.

Payments and privacy
Unlock and contact-release payments run through Stripe. The app stores your session on the device in encrypted OS storage, not in ordinary files. Trade Tender is not a party to the final contract.

Application type: Business.
Privacy policy: https://trade-tender.onrender.com/policies/privacy
Support: https://trade-tender.onrender.com/policies/support
